description: This file declares structures and functions related to walking through reflogs in a version control system, providing interfaces for initializing, releasing, adding entries, displaying messages, and retrieving reflog info.

methods.name: init_reflog_walk
methods.description: Initializes a reflog walk info structure.

methods.name: reflog_walk_info_release
methods.description: Releases resources associated with reflog walk info.

methods.name: add_reflog_for_walk
methods.description: Adds a reflog entry for walking, associating a commit with a name.

methods.name: show_reflog_message
methods.description: Displays a reflog message for a given reflog walk info.

methods.name: get_reflog_message
methods.description: Retrieves the reflog message into a string buffer.

methods.name: get_reflog_ident
methods.description: Returns the reflog identifier as a string.

methods.name: get_reflog_timestamp
methods.description: Retrieves the timestamp of the reflog entry.

methods.name: get_reflog_selector
methods.description: Constructs a reflog selector string based on the reflog info and date mode.

methods.name: reflog_walk_empty
methods.description: Checks if the reflog walk is empty.

methods.name: next_reflog_entry
methods.description: Advances to the next reflog entry in the walk.
